## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behavior change
- [ ] Public exports have JSDoc
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, package README) if behavior or API changed
- [ ] A changeset was added (`pnpm changeset`) if a published package changed
- [ ] No conversation content or app data is sent to the speeq platform (privacy contract)
